explanation.predicate: depends with eq is preferred for new exact dependency reachability queries. With dependency-depth=3 it matches direct or transitive declaration paths through a maximum of three edges. depends-transitive is the legacy depth-2-or-greater spelling and excludes direct-only matches.
explanation.depth_1_note: For direct dependency matching, use exact depends without dependency-depth; dependency-depth=1 is not an accepted value.
explanation.target_note: Traversal requires an explicit dependency-target=<tfm>; all is rejected with dependency-depth or depends-transitive. net8.0 is an example of a NuGet target framework.
